requirements.title: Same generic identifiers require pairwise distinguishability across the whole scope
requirements.definition: Every pair of specific procedures with the same generic identifier within the identifier scope satisfies the rules of this subclause; module-accessed generic procedures apply those rules to all specific versions, including versions inaccessible by specific name.

pending.same-generic-pairwise-rules: PENDING source-control plan: a module generic with three distinguishable specifics records all unordered pairs and maps operator, assignment, defined-I/O, or generic-name cases to C1511, C1512, C1513, or C1514 as appropriate.
pending.module-inaccessible-specifics-included: PENDING source plan: a module exposes a generic name publicly while keeping one specific PRIVATE; a client can call only through the generic, and the source inventory still includes the private specific in pairwise analysis without claiming an extra runtime effect.
pending.pairwise-rules-source-dependency: PENDING audit plan: no fixture may pass an ambiguous generic merely because one specific name is inaccessible; diagnostics are attributed to the relevant numbered constraint, not this prose overview.

requirements.title: TKR compatibility requires compatible type, equal kind type parameters, and equal or assumed rank
requirements.definition: One dummy argument is TKR compatible with another when it is type compatible with the other, corresponding kind type parameters have the same values, and both ranks are the same or either is assumed-rank.

pending.tkr-type-compatibility: PENDING source-control plan: compare integer versus real, parent versus extension, and CLASS(*) cases through generic declarations; resulting ambiguity or admission is credited to the numbered rule that uses this definition.
pending.tkr-kind-parameter-equality: PENDING source-control plan: same type with different integer kind parameters is recorded as non-TKR-compatible only under a generic rule that requires the distinction; exact kind availability guards belong to fixture packets, not this source registration.
pending.tkr-rank-same-or-assumed: PENDING source-control plan: scalar, rank-one, and assumed-rank dummy pairs are catalogued with their TKR relation and then used by C1511-C1514 facets for the actual diagnostic or positive control.

requirements.title: Dummy arguments are distinguishable by procedure/data role, TKR difference, allocatable-pointer attributes, or function rank status
requirements.definition: Two dummy arguments are distinguishable under the four listed alternatives: procedure versus data object, data objects or known functions with neither TKR-compatible with the other, allocatable versus pointer without INTENT(IN) on the pointer side, or a nonzero-rank function versus an entity not known to be a function.

pending.distinguishable-procedure-vs-data: PENDING source-control plan: one generic pair uses a dummy procedure in one specific and a data object in the other, then maps the resulting valid pair to C1514 or C1511 according to the generic identifier form.
pending.distinguishable-non-tkr-data-or-function: PENDING source-control plan: integer scalar versus real scalar and scalar versus rank-one data dummies provide positive distinguishability controls for the numbered generic restrictions.
pending.distinguishable-allocatable-vs-pointer: PENDING source-control plan: one dummy is ALLOCATABLE and the other POINTER without INTENT(IN); a parallel pointer INTENT(IN) mutation prevents this alternative from being claimed.
pending.distinguishable-nonzero-rank-function: PENDING source-control plan: a nonzero-rank function dummy and a data dummy provide a positive control for this bullet, with function characteristics declared explicitly as required by 15.4.3.4.1 p2.

requirements.definition: The effective position of a dummy argument is its position in the argument list after removing any passed-object dummy argument.

requirements.title: Specific procedures override an accessible intrinsic generic on a consistent invocation
requirements.definition: Within the scope of a generic name that matches an intrinsic generic name, the intrinsic is not accessible by that generic name unless the interface procedures and intrinsic are all functions or all subroutines; a generic invocation consistent with both an interface specific and an accessible intrinsic references the interface specific.

pending.intrinsic-generic-still-accessible-for-o: PENDING executable plan in the same scope also calls ABS on a REAL argument not accepted by abs_override and observes the intrinsic nonnegative exact result ABS(-2.0)==2.0, keeping intrinsic accessibility separate from the overriding integer call.
